segments.vv68:1.1: “Cando yathā vigatavalāhake nabhe, obhāsayaṃ gacchati antalikkhe;
segments.vv68:1.3: Tathūpamaṃ tuyhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.
segments.vv68:2.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv68:3.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv68:4.1: “Ahañca bhariyā ca manussaloke, upassayaṃ arahato adamha;
segments.vv68:4.3: Annañca pānañca pasannacittā, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adamha.
segments.vv68:5.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
